name: Simultaneous bidirectional propagation qualifier
aliases: Simultaneous bidirectional propagation qualifier IEC reference
summary: This qualifier distinguishes a path supporting propagation in both directions at the same time.
description: This qualifier distinguishes a path supporting propagation in both directions at the same time. The represented interface supports sending and receiving in opposite directions simultaneously. That operating relationship is separate from the physical media and protocol.
A communications drawing should identify each endpoint and the actual interface. The qualifier supplies a direction relationship without declaring a network implementation.

A bidirectional graphic does not specify a communication protocol or throughput.
